subject: Air freight quote to ORD
body:
Hi there,

Hope your week’s going well. Our buyer in Chicago, US is importing some furniture samples from us in Germany, and I’m arranging the flight for their import. Could you send me an all-in air freight quote in EUR, including a truck you arrange to collect the shipment from our site in 51871 (Bergisch Gladbach), Germany, and take it to the departure airport?

The 5 pieces will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-27, weigh 756.19 lb gross, and take up 54.39 cubic feet. They need to be at ORD by 2026-11-29 at the latest. As long as the shipment arrives by then, price is what will decide which option we book.

Could you attach the offer as a PDF when you reply? Our purchasing department needs it for filing.

Thanks for looking into this!

Cheers,
Klaus Weidner
Weidner Spielwaren GmbH, Nuremberg

classification.reasoning: The customer is requesting a new all-in air freight quote for a specific shipment.
